title: Revealing the dynamic network structure of the Beck Depression Inventory-II
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Limited to two therapy groups; - BDI-II may not capture differences between therapies; - No person-specific analyses due to computational constraints
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention that person-specific analyses are not computationally feasible at the time of publication, which may limit the generalizability of findings. The study used a modified version of the multilevel-VAR method, which may not be fully reproducible without additional details.
